title: ソドミーファタール
description:
Welcome to your totally normal, everyday vampire gay bar! A Vampire Gay Bar Management Sim!

Mix up your very own original "blood drinks," chat with a super unique cast of customers, and run the bar of your dreams!

■ Story Alec is a fabulous flamboyant vampire who runs a gay bar called "Sodomy Fatale." One day, Alec finds Inis—an old-model, general-purpose robot with amnesia—abandoned at the dump and brings him home.

With nowhere else to go, Inis starts working at Alec's bar. Alongside Elena, a young part-time worker, Inis meets all sorts of quirky patrons. Through their conversations, this little robot slowly begins to learn about the warmth of human connection.

It's a laid-back story that's rich in flavor, but goes down smooth!

■ How to Play!• Craft your very own original blood drinks (Hematels)!

• Add your custom Hematels to the bar's menu!

• Listen to what your customers are craving and serve them the perfect drink!

• Keep the drinks flowing to attract special VIP customers!

• Chat with these VIPs to advance the story! 

■ Fun Extra Features!• Create your own BGM playlist for the bar!

• Customize the interior design to fit your vibe!

• Unlock new music and furniture through the in-game Gacha!

• New Hematel ingredients hit the shop as you clear chapters!

• Discover special ingredient combinations to unlock Combos!

• Level up your bar just by serving drinks!

• Equip different Modules to make managing the bar a breeze!

• Try guiding customers to separate rooms! 

■ Heads Up! (Content Warning) This story is deeply rooted in the culture of blood and the night. It includes depictions of homosexuality, smoking, drinking, blood, and some mild mature themes. Please be advised if you are sensitive to these topics!

Please note that while this game is intended for adults, it does not contain any explicit sexual content.
description_short: By Jamsanppoid (From Madness with Love), Sodomy Fatale lets you run a totally normal vampire gay bar! Craft custom "blood drinks" (Hematels), chat with quirky patrons, and attract VIPs. Vibe to original tunes and build your dream bar!
